title: assets/manifest.json
description: What filled each slot, and the SHA-256 of the file the PO handed over. The source hash survives to the output: deck never mutates the PO's file, it fits it with aspect-preserving containment at render time.

stored_file.description: Path under assets/, relative to the deck root. A copy; the original is never touched.

original_path.description: Where the PO's file came from, recorded for provenance.

brief_digest.description: SHA-256 of the slot brief AT IMPORT TIME. An imported asset is REUSED when its container merely moves or resizes, and is only re-requested when this digest no longer matches the storyboard's brief.

superseded_by.description: Set when a later import replaced this one. Entries are appended, never edited in place, so the history of a slot survives.
